title: Toggle Joint
description: Calculate the horizontal force acting in a toggle joint mechanism. The toggle joint consists of two arms linked together with a fixed point, a movable horizontal point, and an effort force acting vertically. This calculator supports both equal and unequal arm lengths.

components.content:
## Toggle Joint Calculator

The toggle mechanism is made of two arms linked together. Point 1 is fixed, point 3 can move horizontally. The effort force acts vertically in point 2.

### Equal Arm Lengths
**P = F × a / (2 × h)**

### Unequal Arm Lengths
**P = F × a / b**

Where:
- **P** = horizontal force in point 3 (N, lb)
- **F** = effort force (N, lb)
- **a** = length of arm (m, ft, mm, in)
- **h** = height (m, ft, mm, in)
- **b** = length of second arm (m, ft, mm, in)
